request.query: Register EU citizen's right of residence (EU registration, Migri)

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: If you stay in Finland for longer than 90 days, you need to visit the Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) to register your EU citizen’s right of residence
Remember to bring your identity card or passport to your appointment
New appointments to visit Migri at IHH open every Thursday between 14-16 for the following week

sources.title: migri.fi
highlights: If you apply for EU registration on the basis of studies, your right of residence can be registered only after your studies have started
Book an appointment in our appointment system (migri.vihta.com) to visit a service point of the Finnish Immigration Service
If you meet the requirements for registration and have presented the necessary attachments, you can get a registration certificate immediately when you visit a service point to prove your identity

sources.title: ihhelsinki.fi
highlights: Then you need to visit Migri’s service point to prove your identity

sources.title: suomi.fi
highlights: You have sufficient financial resources for living in Finland for yourself and for your family members

sources.title: aalto.fi
highlights: The Finnish Immigration Service point in Helsinki is very busy and when you book an appointment, the next available time may be several weeks or even a few months away

sources.title: nordicexpat.com
highlights: The practical takeaway: apply early, attach clean documents, and book the in-person appointment as soon as slots allow, because the appointment is often the real bottleneck rather than the decision itself
